headline: Claude Code 2.1.310 and Antigravity CLI 1.4.7 shipped, and agy's plugin sign-in change needs one action.

themes.title: Sandboxes and MCP servers are locked down
themes.facts: Claude Code stopped sandboxed commands from changing the `--mcp-config` file ([2.1.309](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.309)); agy blocks `~/.docker`, `~/.kube` and `~/_netrc` in its sandbox unless you grant access ([1.4.6](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.6)); Kilo Code treats shell expressions in MCP prompts as plain text ([v7.8.16](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.16)).
themes.so_what: any sandbox or MCP setup that worked by accident may now need an explicit grant.

themes.title: Defaults and rewind behave differently now
themes.facts: Codex Guardian v2 now defaults to conversation mode, so its verdicts can differ ([rust-v0.164.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.164.0)); Claude Code's `/rewind` no longer undoes `sed -i` edits, and `claude ultrareview` needs workspace trust in scripts ([2.1.309](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.309)).
themes.so_what: scripts and reviews that ran unattended before may now stop or change output, so check them before you rely on them.

themes.title: Plugins get their own checks and new sign-in rules
themes.facts: `agy plugin validate --strict --json` uses the CLI's own loader rules, so you can run it in CI and fail on warnings ([1.4.0](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.0)); `/plugin` now sets a plugin's MCP server variables without disabling it ([1.4.6](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.6)); plugin MCP tokens now belong to the signed-in user, so OAuth servers may ask you to sign in again ([1.4.7](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.7)).
themes.so_what: if you write plugins for more than one agent, test them in each one's validator, and expect a one-time sign-in after the agy 1.4.7 update.

watch_next: Claude Code 2.1.310 fixes compaction and hook edge cases, but the 2.1.309 changes to `ultrareview` and `/rewind` may still break scripts. OpenCode 2 is still opt-in; the day a v2 release becomes "Latest" will be big news.
